string.text: A lightweight tactical bomber suit designed for rapid assault operations. Reinforced with flexible armor plates, it provides balanced protection without restricting mobility.
The standard-issue combat uniform of the MilStalk brigade, offering reliable ballistic protection and resistance against harsh environmental effects.
An elite special-operations combat suit with reinforced armor layers, tactical camouflage, and improved stealth capabilities for high-risk missions.
A fortified military suit favored by frontline MilStalk units. It provides increased ballistic resistance and additional anomaly protection.
An early prototype exoskeleton offering enhanced strength and solid protection. Less refined than full exosuits, but highly effective in the field.
A fully powered military exoskeleton engineered for maximum survivability. Its reinforced frame grants exceptional protection and load-bearing capacity.
An advanced “Nosorog” armor variant with composite plating and exoskeletal support. Balances mobility with extraordinary defensive capability for elite units.
